lyrics:
Here's the fully restructured, ~5000-character Suno-formatted track with multilingual tags, new style tags, and a title. Languages used: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Mandarin (top 5 global).

Title: DATA OR NOISE (On-Chain Mind)

text
[style: cinematic dark phonk, progressive psytrance build, wide orchestral synths, 
bioacoustic percussion — whale sonar pulses, wolf pack howls pitched to 808s, 
bird flock wing-beat hi-hats, deep cave drip sub-bass, swarm drone pads, 
high energy with dynamic drops, vocoder FX, dual-language call-response, 
dark analytical energy, tempo 128–140 BPM]

[Intro – female vocoder, filtered → opening up, whale sonar ping FX, 
cave drip sub-bass rises]
Scanning the chain.
Deux cent cinquante indicateurs.
Two hundred and fifty indicators online.
Doscientos indicadores… activos.
一个问题，一个使命。
Data… or noise?
Queda nos dados. Não no ruído.
Stay grounded in data — not noise.

[Verse 1 – male, dry wit, conversational, wolf-pack low pad beneath, 
builds like a storm radar locking on]
Tom. Particle physics degree,
Long-haul pilot brain at thirty thousand feet.
Used to reading instruments inside a storm of rain,
Now he points that lens at every Bitcoin trade and pain.

Land the plane, open the laptop,
Bitcoin chart, coffee, full stop.
Cansado de analistas dibujando líneas al azar,
Justificando calls que no tienen lugar.

The market screams stories every single day,
But on-chain flows tell it a different way.
Les manchettes flippent d'euphorie à la douleur,
Il compte ceux qui saignent — donnée, pas rumeur.

When will the pain stop? Not when tweets say so,
When the cohort underwater starts letting go.
Price is just surface — stress is underneath,
Time spent below cost is the pain in their teeth.

[Hook – male + female vocoder, swarm drone pad surges, 
bird wing hi-hats scatter left-right stereo]
Is it data, or noise?
É sinal, ou só mais uma voz?
Same chart, two different poise,
On-Chain Mind cuts through the toys.
Data, not noise —
C'est l'outil, pas juste un choix.
If you're tired of the guessing boys,
Tune in calm — On-Chain Mind.

[Verse 2 – male, faster, locked in, whale sonar hits harder on each bar]
Un tipo en YouTube dijo que el fondo llegó,
Dibujó una línea, llamó ganador lo que no.
Meanwhile the on-chain data said wait,
Smart money moving at a different rate.

Cent jours de trading sous le prix d'achat récent,
Les investisseurs réactifs crient "pourquoi, comment?"
Capitulation zones, Ω‑Score low,
Deep drawdown — but what does that show?

两百五十个指标，不是猜测，
周期框架，承载所有压力和热。
Time is a catalyst — not just the fall,
Bear markets end when exhaustion hits all.

From "How Low Can Bitcoin Go?" to "Violent move ahead,"
He doesn't sell fear — he shows you what the chain said.
Holders, flows, long-term supply waking up or letting go,
Dados da chain — isso é o que você precisa saber.

[Short ad-lib – female vocoder, panned hard left, 
animal sonar echo, minimal beat]
No es drama — es estructura.
Não é hype — é leitura.
Ce n'est pas du bruit — c'est la donnée.
数据，不是噪音。

[Chorus – full blend, orchestral synth swell, 
bioacoustic percussion peaks — wolf howl 808 hits on the drop]
We got two readings — on-chain and off,
One sees the signal, one sees the froth.
Same market, two different takes,
On-Chain Mind, we catch your mistakes.

Temos dois leituras — dados e drama,
Uma vê o sinal, a outra só a chama.
Même marché, deux visions distinctes,
On-Chain Mind — l'analyse instincte.

Is it data, or noise?
Same chart, two different poise,
On-Chain Mind cuts through the toys.

[Verse 3 – male, deadpan → legendary, 
instruments drop to cave drip sub-bass only, 
builds back up like a tidal wave]
Un movimiento violento viene — lo dijo tranquilo,
Sin CAPS LOCK, sin pánico, sin estilo.
Just a chart, a cycle map, a clean take,
Here's the data… make your own mistake.

七千读者，感觉像一个房间，
严肃的思维问：熊市还是繁荣的时间？
Six thousand nine hundred users found him,
Thirty thousand subs surround him.

Not because he hypes the number up,
Because he fills the serious analyst cup.
Deux modèles, une question — combien vaut Bitcoin?
Pas des lignes d'espoir — du travail sous le destin.

DCA, lump sum — o que encaixa no seu plano?
Ele mostra o framework — você decide o seu ano.
He's not here to tell you "buy now, all in,"
He's here to show regime — where trend might begin.

[Bridge – male, very calm, all instruments drop to 
single whale sonar ping + cave drip, 
no drums, pure space]
No hype.
No guesswork.
Just a pilot reading instruments.
Mismo cielo. Diferente altitud.
Même ciel. Altitude différente.
同一片天空。不同的高度。
On-chain data.
Full stop.
Bear or bull — the data speaks,
If you listen long enough.

[Final Hook – group anthemic, all bioacoustic layers 
return at once, swarm + whale + wolf + wing-beats, 
full orchestral drop]
Data, or noise?
Signal, or voice?
Dados ou ruído — qual é sua escolha?
¿Señal o drama? — la cadena te aconseja.
数据还是噪音？链上告诉你。

Same chart, 
different poise,
On-Chain Mind 
cuts through the toys.
